items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Nola called up Paul White, and said, I want to play something for you... He says, I don't believe it, but I'll be down there.

ctx.x: And sure enough, we played that dance and Willy Bryant came down there to M.C. the show (inaudible). Said,

man,that band will upset the place. So he came on to New York and I went to Nova Studio and made a demo at 8:00 at night. And Nola called it and went and called up Paul White, and said, I want to play something for you. Said, who do you think this is?

Well, I don't know, I don't know, it's great. He says, girls. He says, I don't believe it, but I'll be down there. Then he called up W.C. Handy and let him in, he say I'll be there with my trumpet to do an opening. But the musicians came back stage and they demanded to see this boys' band behind the curtains.
